scope.es: Ampliación de literatura para isquemia, repolarización y enfermedad estructural/sistémica en adultos. No modifica criterios ejecutables, umbrales, fórmulas, exactitud diagnóstica ni urgencia.
scope.en: Literature enrichment for adult ischaemia, repolarization and structural/systemic disease. Does not change executable criteria, thresholds, formulae, diagnostic accuracy or urgency.

method.primaryRetrieval: Healthcare Public Data native PubMed search/get and rights-eligible PMC full-text connector
method.fallback: Exa fetch of official JACC, AHA and Oxford/ESC full-text sections
method.fullTextMeaning: Claim-relevant body sections reviewed; not a claim that every page or guideline recommendation was reviewed.
method.copyright: Only bibliographic metadata and original bilingual synthesis are public; full texts and abstracts remain in ignored artifacts/literature/systemic.
method.searchLimit: Focused enrichment, not a systematic review; search results were selected by relevance, current guidance and accessible claim-level text.

sources.population: Adults with suspected or confirmed ACS
sources.locator: Table 3; sections 3.1.1–3.1.2, recommendations 1–4 and supportive text

summary.es: El ECG inicial normal o no diagnóstico no excluye SCA; los síntomas persistentes o el deterioro requieren ECG seriados y troponina. V7–V9 y derivaciones derechas se seleccionan según la sospecha clínica.
summary.en: A normal or nondiagnostic initial ECG does not exclude ACS; persistent symptoms or deterioration call for serial ECGs and troponin assessment. Posterior and right-sided leads depend on clinical suspicion.

sources.limitations: One guideline copublished as PMID 40013746 and PMID 40014670; counted once. Relevant full-text diagnostic sections reviewed; no new executable thresholds or treatment rules.

summary.es: La corrección modifica los efectos adversos de ezetimiba y la inicial de una revisora; no cambia los criterios ECG revisados.
summary.en: The correction changes the ezetimibe adverse-effect entry and a reviewer initial; it does not change the reviewed ECG criteria.

sources.limitations: Version-control record linked to the parent guideline; not independent diagnostic evidence.

summary.es: La segunda corrección modifica la cita y una nota de monitorización de heparina; no cambia los criterios ECG revisados.
summary.en: The second correction changes the citation and a heparin-monitoring footnote; it does not change the reviewed ECG criteria.

sources.limitations: Version-control record, not independent diagnostic evidence. Drug dosing was not incorporated.

sources.population: Adult emergency patients with chest pain and ST elevation
sources.locator: Sections STEMI; LVH; LBBB; RV paced rhythm; myocarditis/myopericarditis; LV aneurysm

summary.es: HVI, BRI, estimulación ventricular, repolarización precoz, miopericarditis y aneurisma ventricular pueden simular IAMCEST. El ECG previo y la evolución ayudan; una causa alternativa no descarta infarto coexistente.
summary.en: LVH, LBBB, ventricular pacing, early repolarization, myopericarditis and ventricular aneurysm can mimic STEMI. Prior and serial ECGs help; an alternative cause does not exclude coexisting infarction.

sources.limitations: Narrative review; no pooled diagnostic accuracy. Concave ST morphology or short-term stability alone must not be used to rule out ACS.

sources.population: Selected international cohorts with suspected ACS; test set 2222 patients, 3254 ECGs
sources.locator: Methods: study design and OMI definition; Results: comparison with STEMI; Limitations

summary.es: La oclusión coronaria puede no cumplir criterios milimétricos de IAMCEST; el estudio apoya mantener la sospecha clínica cuando persisten síntomas.
summary.en: Coronary occlusion may fail to meet STEMI millimetre criteria; the study supports continued clinical suspicion when symptoms persist.

sources.limitations: Retrospective selected cohorts; broad OMI endpoint included flow-limiting lesions. AI performance is not validation of this rule engine, cannot supply its sensitivity/LRs, and has not established mortality benefit.

sources.population: Suspected myocarditis and/or pericarditis; app applies adult scope

summary.es: Los cambios ST-T o PR apoyan un síndrome inflamatorio, pero un ECG normal no lo excluye. En pericarditis, los cambios ECG sugieren afectación miocárdica y deben motivar su evaluación.
summary.en: ST-T or PR changes support an inflammatory syndrome, but a normal ECG does not exclude it. ECG changes in pericarditis suggest myocardial involvement and warrant its assessment.

sources.limitations: PubMed has no abstract; substantive support comes from the official full-text sections, not metadata. ECG alone cannot establish definite myocarditis or the clinical diagnosis of pericarditis.

summary.es: El ECG es una prueba inicial con hallazgos inespecíficos; un trazado normal o inespecífico no descarta miocarditis.
summary.en: ECG is an initial test with nonspecific findings; a normal or nonspecific tracing cannot exclude myocarditis.

sources.limitations: 2024-named pathway published in JACC in 2025. Reviewed ECG section; no numerical sensitivity imported into engine.

sources.population: Adults with suspected acute or chronic digoxin toxicity
sources.locator: Table 1; Diagnosis of digoxin toxicity; Serum digoxin concentrations

summary.es: El efecto digitálico puede aparecer sin toxicidad. El diagnóstico exige clínica, función renal, electrolitos y niveles de digoxina interpretados según el tiempo de ingesta; los niveles no se correlacionan de forma constante con toxicidad.
summary.en: Digitalis effect can occur without toxicity. Diagnosis integrates symptoms, renal function, electrolytes and digoxin levels interpreted against ingestion timing; levels do not consistently correlate with toxicity.

sources.limitations: Expert consensus with limited clinical evidence, not a universally accepted guideline. No ECG sign or serum value alone proves or excludes toxicity; no antidote dosing added.

sources.population: Patients exposed to QT-prolonging medicines; app applies adult scope
sources.locator: QT measurement; Assessing risk; Drug interactions; Monitoring; When to refer

summary.es: Revisar medición del QT, frecuencia, ancho del QRS, electrolitos e interacciones. El QTc aislado no atribuye causalidad a un fármaco ni cuantifica el riesgo individual de torsades.
summary.en: Review QT measurement, heart rate, QRS width, electrolytes and interactions. Isolated QTc does not assign drug causality or quantify individual torsades risk.

sources.limitations: Clinical review, not a prospective risk model. Bazett may overcorrect at fast rates and undercorrect at slow rates; ordinary QT interpretation is unreliable with abnormal QRS duration. No formula or threshold changed.

sources.population: Hospitalized dofetilide/sotalol recipients: HFpEF 109, HFrEF 138, no HF 729
sources.locator: Methods; Results; Discussion and study limitations

summary.es: La insuficiencia cardíaca, también con fracción de eyección preservada, se asoció con más prolongación del QT durante dofetilida o sotalol en esta cohorte hospitalaria.
summary.en: Heart failure, including preserved ejection fraction, was associated with more QT prolongation during dofetilide or sotalol exposure in this inpatient cohort.

sources.limitations: Retrospective drug-specific inpatient cohort; incomplete baseline/daily ECGs and possible residual confounding. QT prolongation was the endpoint, not proof of torsades, drug causality, or general risk for every medicine.

sources.population: 67 adults with serum potassium at least 5.5 mmol/L in a single emergency department
sources.locator: Methods; Results: ECG findings; Discussion: limitations; Conclusions

summary.es: La ausencia de cambios ECG no descarta hiperpotasemia; se requiere potasio sérico y evaluación clínica. El estudio encontró ECG normales incluso entre pacientes con hiperpotasemia confirmada.
summary.en: Absent ECG changes do not exclude hyperkalemia; serum potassium and clinical assessment are required. Normal ECGs occurred despite laboratory-confirmed hyperkalemia.

sources.limitations: Small single-centre sample without a normokalemic control group; specificity and predictive values cannot be estimated. Reader performance is not an accuracy estimate for this engine.

sources.population: Patients with suspected Takotsubo versus acute MI
sources.locator: ECG; Echocardiography; Coronary angiography; CMR; Conclusions

summary.es: Takotsubo y el infarto pueden compartir dolor, troponina elevada y cambios ECG. La diferenciación requiere evaluación coronaria y cardíaca por imagen según el contexto; puede haber complicaciones graves.
summary.en: Takotsubo and infarction can share chest pain, troponin elevation and ECG changes. Differentiation requires coronary evaluation and cardiac imaging according to context; serious complications can occur.

sources.limitations: Narrative review. No single ECG appearance establishes Takotsubo; stress history and apparent recovery potential must not delay ACS evaluation.

sources.population: Suspected or established cardiomyopathy; adult recommendations used
sources.locator: Phänotyporientierter diagnostischer Pfad; Multimodale Bildgebung; Genetisches Testen

summary.es: La sospecha ECG de miocardiopatía requiere un estudio multiparamétrico con clínica, familia, monitorización y ecocardiografía/RM; el patrón ECG no confirma el fenotipo ni la causa genética.
summary.en: ECG suspicion of cardiomyopathy requires multiparametric evaluation with symptoms, family history, monitoring and echo/CMR; the ECG pattern does not establish phenotype or genetic cause.

sources.limitations: German-language secondary review of ESC 2023, not independent validation of ECG criteria. Most guideline recommendations rest on limited trials/expert consensus.

sources.population: Known or suspected cardiomyopathy; adult scope retained

summary.es: El ECG puede preceder al fenotipo estructural y ocasionalmente ser normal. Voltajes altos o bajos y preexcitación son pistas que deben interpretarse junto con imagen y contexto familiar.
summary.en: ECG abnormalities may precede the structural phenotype, and ECG can occasionally be normal. High/low voltages and preexcitation are clues to interpret with imaging and family context.

sources.limitations: Existing reference rechecked, not a net-new source. High voltage alone is not HCM and low voltage alone is not amyloidosis. Phenocopies and coexisting disease require clinical evaluation.

summary.en: The third correction changes an enoxaparin dosing unit in Table 10; it does not change the reviewed ECG criteria.

retrievalGaps.reason: PubMed record has no abstract; no substantive text retrieved. Not integrated or marked verified. Official ESC 2025 guideline sections were retrieved instead.

deduplication.reason: Same 2025 ACS guideline copublished in JACC and Circulation; counted once. Errata are version records, not independent clinical evidence.
Existing source updated in place; not counted as new. Pavo 2024 is a secondary guideline review, not independent diagnostic validation.

citationAudit.reason: The former shared ID collapsed two distinct 2012 papers in the merged bibliography. All references within this domain were retargeted; numerical criteria unchanged.
Distinct early repolarization versus subtle anterior STEMI paper; citation identity confirmed through native PubMed. Reference-only correction; no executable threshold changes.
